g.text: Default distributions versus exact event probabilities.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #627884

g.text: 96 exact-probability cases, 48 paired settings. Not single-outcome accuracy, not correctness-confidence calibration; no fitting on test probabilities.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #627884

g.text: Reference probabilities are checked as exact fractions. Error bars: 95% paired-setting bootstrap intervals. Invalid outputs are reported with valid denominators.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #627884
